Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: A financial transaction (expense or income) categorized by the user or synced from a bank account.

type.description: Whether the transaction is an expense or income.

category.description: Category key (e.g., FOOD, HOUSING, TRANSPORT, ENTERTAINMENT, HEALTH, SHOPPING, UTILITIES, SALARY, INVESTMENT, SAVINGS).

accountId.description: Associated bank account ID or CASH.

accountName.description: Display name of the bank account.

yearMonth.description: Year-month string in YYYY-MM format for monthly filtering and charts.

isBankSynced.description: True if imported via automatic bank synchronization.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BankAccount.title: BankAccount
BankAccount.description: A user's linked bank account or wallet for automatic transaction synchronization and balance tracking.

currency.description: Currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, COP, MXN).

autoSyncEnabled.description: Whether automatic bank sync is enabled.

externalInstitutionId.description: External Open Banking / Plaid institution identifier.

lastSyncSummary.description: Summary status of the last bank sync.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CategoryBudget.title: CategoryBudget
CategoryBudget.description: Monthly budget and savings goal limit per category for the user.

monthlyLimit.description: Target monthly limit or savings goal.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/bank_accounts/{accountId.description: Per-user linked bank accounts for automatic synchronization.

/users/{userId}/budgets/{budgetId}.description: Per-user monthly category budgets and savings targets.
